metrics.ph_desc: Measure of acidity or alkalinity of the water (range 0-14).
metrics.dissolvedOxygen_desc: The amount of oxygen dissolved in the water, essential for aquatic life.
metrics.temperature_desc: The temperature of the water, affecting chemical and biological processes.
metrics.waterLevel_desc: The height of the water level relative to a baseline reference point.
metrics.turbidity_desc: The cloudiness or haziness of water caused by suspended particles.
metrics.macroinvertebrate_desc: Presence of small organisms used as bioindicators of water quality.
metrics.lab_ph_desc: Laboratory verified measure of acidity or alkalinity (pH scale 0–14).
metrics.lab_temperature_desc: Laboratory verified water temperature measured at the time of sampling (°C).
metrics.lab_dissolved_oxygen_desc: Laboratory measurement of dissolved oxygen content in water (mg/L).
metrics.bod_desc: Biochemical Oxygen Demand (mg/L): amount of dissolved oxygen consumed by microorganisms decomposing organic matter.
metrics.orthophosphate_desc: Dissolved reactive phosphorus (mg/L) available for aquatic plant uptake.
metrics.nitrate_desc: Concentration of nitrate in water (mg/L), an indicator of agricultural runoff and organic pollution.
metrics.heavy_metals_desc: Qualitative or semi-quantitative screening for toxic heavy metals (lead, cadmium, arsenic).
metrics.total_nitrogen_desc: Sum of all nitrogen forms in water (mg/L), critical for evaluating eutrophication risk.
metrics.total_phosphorus_desc: Total concentration of all phosphorus forms in water (mg/L).
